candidate_search_budget: ONE new from-scratch RGB run, seed 20261101, 20 epochs and exactly three candidates at 5/10/20. No warm-start, identity loss, margin/feature/gain sweep or extra seed. Separate from preserved V1/V2 budgets. Future controlled depth comparison must match this entire RGB architecture, scene context, data, optimizer, objective and budget if retained.
selection_policy: Diagnostic-only evaluation of all three candidates first. A separately recorded diagnostic acceptance is required before selection. Formal selection uses all three candidates, artifact screen first, mean native PSNR; ties within 0.01 dB use SSIM then earlier step. No final-test/challenging access.
review_rubric: Zero major artifacts and at most four minor cases of 40; same original rubric and two independent review records. No aggregate score overrides artifact failure.
diagnostic_continuation: At least one candidate must meet or exceed BOTH reused reconstruction-only control diagnostic means (PSNR 19.803105354309082, SSIM 0.8697630226612091), with fixed-eight native review establishing no new major defects. This is exploratory, not statistical noninferiority or checkpoint selection. If the gate fails, preserve results and do not automatically sweep or extend epochs. Success does not select a checkpoint.
rationale: Fixed-eight oracle fits motivate testing learnable colour conditioning, but the input-only ridge failed. Test end-to-end reconstruction-supervised nonlinear colour prediction WITH retained local spatial correction, using full native input moments during crop training. This is an unproven architecture hypothesis, not a known repair.
